description: Traversal walk selector defaulting: any value other than the exact string breadth_first (missing key, uppercase variant, bogus token, or non-string type) falls back to the depth_first branch.

input.scenario: walk key absent -> default depth_first branch

cases.expected_output:
walk=depth_first
from_H_count=4
from_H_order=["H", "I", "K", "J"]
from_I_count=3
reverse_from_H_count=1
reverse_from_K_count=3

input.scenario: uppercase walk is not breadth_first so depth_first branch runs

cases.expected_output:
walk=depth_first
from_H_count=4
from_H_order=["H", "I", "K", "J"]
from_I_count=3
reverse_from_H_count=1
reverse_from_K_count=3

input.scenario: unrecognized walk token falls back to depth_first

cases.expected_output:
walk=depth_first
from_H_count=4
from_H_order=["H", "I", "K", "J"]
from_I_count=3
reverse_from_H_count=1
reverse_from_K_count=3

input.scenario: non-string walk coerces to empty and defaults to depth_first

cases.expected_output:
walk=depth_first
from_H_count=4
from_H_order=["H", "I", "K", "J"]
from_I_count=3
reverse_from_H_count=1
reverse_from_K_count=3
